description: This file implements the 'NeedData' class, which handles the logic for signaling the need for media data (audio/video) in a GStreamer-based media player context. It interacts with the media source information, updates internal flags, and notifies a client when media data is needed.

classes.name: NeedData
classes.description: A class responsible for handling 'need data' events in the media streaming context, signaling when more media data (audio/video) is required.

methods.name: NeedData::NeedData
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the NeedData object with the media context, client, and source.

methods.name: NeedData::~NeedData
methods.description: Destructor that logs the cleanup of the NeedData object.

methods.name: NeedData::execute
methods.description: Executes the logic to determine if media data is needed for audio or video streams and notifies the client accordingly.
